Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Job report article – unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Eve! I visited your blog. Nice, clear introduction, and hiking is a great topic. Feedback: add more content, such as hiking stories, photos, favorite trails and tips, plus some structure (categories, posts) to make it more engaging for readers.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and sharing a contact email is helpful. Feedback: add more about yourself, such as your work, projects or interests, and some visuals and navigation to make it more engaging and professional.
